description: Ministry of Sports - Amendment of the National Association of Sports Regulation No. 01 of 2016, published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1990/23 of 27.10.2016
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It focuses on legal amendments to existing sports regulations, detailing procedural requirements for sports association registration, grading, and election committees. The content primarily deals with regulatory frameworks and legal modifications rather than government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories.
